name: Andorra

flag.description: A vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and red, with the yellow centre band slightly wider than the others and bearing the national coat of arms.
flag.symbolism: The colours combine those of France and Catalonia, reflecting Andorra's two co-princes; the arms unite the mitre and crozier of the Bishop of Urgell with the emblems of Foix, Catalonia and Béarn.

hook: Blue-yellow-red with a shield of mitre, stripes and two red cows in the middle: Andorra's crest has no eagle (that's Moldova), and plain Romania and Chad have no crest at all.
trivia: The motto on the coat of arms is the Latin 'Virtus Unita Fortior', meaning 'Virtue united is stronger'.
Andorra has two heads of state at once: the Bishop of Urgell in Spain and the President of France serve as co-princes.
Andorra la Vella, at roughly 1,000 metres above sea level, is the highest capital city in Europe.
